package rulefixtures

import "bytes"

// scenario for append_then_trim_each_iteration: Slice append followed by reslice each iteration instead of batching.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: hot_path; severity: info.

func scenario342Positive(items []string) string {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	for _, item := range items {
		oldLen := buf.Len()
		buf.WriteString(item)
		result := buf.String()
		_ = result
		buf.Truncate(oldLen)
	}
	return buf.String()
}
